say:1:1130942001:1.text: It's that terrabird with the bad leg! I saved it once before!
say:1:1130942001:1.source_cn: 一只脚上有伤的陆行鸟！我之前救过它！

say:2:1130942002:1.text: It's extremely gentle for its kind, and it runs off whenever it sees people. It won't even stand up to the other terrabirds.
say:2:1130942002:1.source_cn: 它特别温顺，胆子也很小，看到人就立刻跑开，也不敢和其他...

say:3:1130942003:1.text: But when I came to bring it some fruit today, I found it fighting with other animals!
say:3:1130942003:1.source_cn: 可是今天，我拿着水果来看它的时候，它在和其他动物打成一团！

say:4:1130942004:1.text: It looked so vicious... and it didn't seem to remember me at all. As soon as it saw me, it charged at me with its beak wide open!
say:4:1130942004:1.source_cn: 而且，它变得好凶哦……好像不认识我了一样，张着嘴向我扑过来！

say:5:1130942005:1.text: It scared me so badly that I ran away... and when I came back, Cacaja was nowhere to be found...
say:5:1130942005:1.source_cn: 我、我太害怕，逃走了……再回来看时，库库亚也不见了……
